market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move is sustained or a thin-liquidity blip; cross-check 2y/10y Treasury yields and fed funds futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Look for any macro catalyst (weak data, dovish Fed speak, risk event) that would justify a genuine repricing rather than noise.
time_plan.2h: Reassess TLT vs. move in SOFR/fed funds futures; confirm direction consistency across the curve.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether bond rally holds into the US session; watch for reversal if equities rally (soft-landing interpretation) rather than sell off.
time_plan.12h: Mark TLT return vs. entry; assess whether the prediction-market shift preceded any public data or Fed communication.

predictions.reasoning: An abrupt rise in the implied probability of 8 Fed cuts in 2026 signals a sharply more dovish/recessionary path for policy. A deep-easing scenario pulls the expected fed funds path lower, which mechanically lifts long-duration Treasury prices as the front-end and belly reprice lower in yield. TLT is the most liquid, directly-exposed proxy for this repricing.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the dovish repricing is real via DXY and real-yield moves (TIPS); ignore if dollar is not softening.
time_plan.1h: Check gold spot vs. real yields for coherence; watch for competing drivers (risk-on equity rally that saps safe-haven bid).
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether dollar weakness persists; gold thesis fails if USD strengthens.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate gold move into US trading; look for divergence from the rates signal.
time_plan.12h: Mark GLD return; judge whether move was driven by rate expectations or unrelated flows.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in the odds of 8 cuts implies materially lower real rates and a weaker dollar, both classically supportive for gold. Deep-easing expectations also often accompany recession/risk fears that boost safe-haven demand. GLD is a liquid proxy, though the link is weaker and slower than the direct rates channel.

evidence_used: Market question tracks number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026; the 8-cut strike represents an extreme dovish/recessionary easing scenario
A sharp rise in this strike's implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive easing
Standard macro transmission: lower expected fed funds path -> lower yields -> higher long-bond prices, lower dollar, higher gold
uncertainty_notes: The mislabeled 'military_conflict' topic suggests metadata is unreliable; the market is purely a monetary-policy question
8 cuts is a tail scenario with likely low base probability, so probability moves may be noisy and thin
700bps tradable threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for these macro proxies, so neither is likely 'tradable' by that bar
Equities are ambiguous: deep cuts could be read as recession (bearish) or stimulus (bullish), so no clean equity call

llm_justification.summary: The market gauges the odds of an extreme 8-cut Fed easing in 2026. A sharp upward move in that probability would signal a dovish/recessionary repricing of the policy path, implying lower yields (bond prices up, TLT up), a weaker dollar, and firmer gold. These are the cleanest liquid proxies, but expected 12h magnitudes are modest and well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-conviction, research-only mapping.
key_assumptions: A probability move in this strike reflects genuine shifts in Fed-path expectations rather than thin-market noise
Rate-path repricing transmits normally to Treasuries, the dollar, and gold
No offsetting risk-sentiment shock dominates the tape
failure_modes: The probability move is a thin-liquidity artifact with no real information content
The dovish signal was already public (post-data or post-Fed-speak), so assets already priced it
Equity/risk interpretation dominates and gold/bonds decouple from the rate signal
8 cuts implies recession, which could paradoxically strengthen the dollar via safe-haven flows, breaking the gold-up thesis
Magnitudes far below the 700bps threshold make any 'tradable' claim invalid
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
